translations./garage/brief: Same road, three tire types. Predict which one stops shortest, then let RO-1 answer with its wheels.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. After the run, compare braking, time, and energy in the evidence.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Record your prediction. At the exit, compare braking distance and energy use.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Efficiency tires are both fastest and most efficient
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Fast and efficient can pull in different directions. Let the braking distance and energy data decide.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: I can feel the new tires gripping.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Same road, different shoes, different result.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Try a tire with more grip or a gentler driving preference.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Time, energy, and clearance come from the live simulation, not scripted values.
